اشتعلتن (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلْتُنَّ (ištaʕaltunna) /iʃ.ta.ʕal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اُشْتُعِلْتُنَّ (uštuʕiltunna) /uʃ.tu.ʕil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
